E7 on R3 improves the fit by 0.0018 overall (1.67078 against 1.67258).

| Readings | ΔNLL |
|---|---|
| glucose_finger | +0.0015 |
| glucose_lab | +0.0010 |
| map_arterial | −0.0027 |
| map_cuff | −0.0045 |

So E7 is neutral or helpful on all 300 new stays: −0.0016, +0.0004 and −0.0018. map_cuff improves steadily, which hints that freeing the four hidden units removed some slight harm in the original head on map rows.

The one set still missing for E7 is sel1, the hardest set so far. There E6, without the NE channel, cost +0.0009. Measuring E7 on it completes the 400-stay picture and isolates the cost of the 0.4 NE channel on sel1 (E7 minus E6 on identical stays).
- I expect about +0.002.
- If that holds, the pooled cost is near zero, and I can raise insulin to full gain and possibly NE to about 0.6. The projection will come from the per-reading data.
